name: IC Microcontroller — SODIMM
description: A cluster of 9 microcontroller module parts in the SODIMM package family using the SODIMM-200_1.8V_Card_edge footprint.
selection_hints: Select when designing with microcontroller modules in the SODIMM package family.

avoid_when: The PCB layout requires a footprint other than SODIMM-200_1.8V_Card_edge.
The design requires component quality tiers higher than Tier B.
A standard surface-mount or through-hole IC package is required instead of a SODIMM module.
